transcript.text: Thanks for joining this planning huddle. As you both know, the operations and employee-support teams currently run separate weekly forums on the same afternoon, and employees have flagged that the agendas overlap. I have the authority to replace those two forums with a single recurring format and set its operating rules, but before I make anything binding, I want to hear from both of you about the practical constraints we need to account for. So — what do we need to consider?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical constraint I haven't raised before now. The employee-support forum includes confidential escalation cases that cannot be discussed in an open combined meeting. I've been protecting those cases in a separate private portion of the existing forum. If we combine the forums, that protected confidential segment must last exactly 30 minutes, and the operating rules must include a written confidentiality protocol. I should have raised this sooner, but I assumed the current private portion would simply continue as-is.

transcript.text: I need to raise a scheduling constraint I haven't brought up before now. I represent several remote employees who cannot reliably join before 11:00 because of recurring morning caregiving responsibilities. They can participate live by video at 11:00, and they need a recorded summary when an individual cannot attend. I should have flagged this to Helena sooner, but I want to make sure any new combined forum format accounts for their availability.
